Replacement algorithms: Least Recently Used (LRU), First-In First-Out (FIFO), Random.

Write-through with bus snooping: Invalidating or updating remote caches upon local write.
Snoopy cache protocols: MSI, MESI (Modified, Exclusive, Shared, Invalid) state transition automata.
Directory-based cache coherence: Centralized or distributed directory tracking cache presence.
Software solutions: Compiler-assisted cacheability analysis and shared variable bypass.
